description: Public Service Commission - Appointments made by the Public Service Commission - The Senior Assistant Secretaries and the Additional Secretaries
categorisation: This gazette contains public service appointments made by the Public Service Commission, specifically detailing the assignment of Senior Assistant Secretary positions to various ministries. The content focuses on public sector recruitment and administrative assignments within government departments, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government personnel changes (which would be Type 2) since these are administrative service appointments rather than ministerial or high-level government personnel changes.
